title: Trump Wants to Give Out $5,000 Checks. It Would Cost More Than $1 Trillion.
summary: The president’s idea to hand every American adult a “dividend” if Republicans keep control of Congress likely would need congressional approval, exacerbate the deficit and lead to a rise in inflation, experts said.
